annotations.title: Verify Agentic Base USDC On-Chain Payment & Unlock Bundle

description: Verify an autonomous x402 Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) USDC ERC-20 transfer tx_hash to the Calligraphy Treasury Wallet with strict anti-replay protection and immediately unlock bundle downloads. Use after calligraphy_get_crypto_payment_intent (use calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment for multi-chain or USDT). Requires job_id and tx_hash; returns JSON unlocked=True. Example: job_id='job_01'.

job_id.description: Compilation job identifier being unlocked by Base USDC transfer.

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 66-character Base Mainnet (8453) USDC ERC-20 transfer tx_hash.
